# Labels

Create these once ; delete GitHub's default labels you do not use.
The release notes template (`.github/release.yml`) groups by `breaking`, `safety`, `enhancement`, `bug` and `docs`.

| Label | Colour | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `bug` | d73a4a | something is broken |
| `enhancement` | 0e8a16 | a request; the maintainer plans it first |
| `docs` | 0075ca | README and guides |
| `breaking` | e99695 | a change to read before updating |
| `platform: macos` | 5319e7 | macOS specific |
| `platform: linux` | 5319e7 | Linux specific |
| `platform: wsl2` | 5319e7 | WSL 2 specific |
| `panel` | 1d76db | the VS Code panel |
| `safety` | b60205 | the gate, hard stops, owner proof (never post secrets) |
| `needs-repro` | fbca04 | asked for steps and `shipm init --check` output |
| `good first issue` | 7057ff | small, with tests |
| `wontfix` | ffffff | closed with a reason |
| `duplicate` | ffffff | closed, points to the original |
